verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no statement about how OpenAI or Anthropic handle note content sent through Reflect's AI features. End-to-end encryption, meaning servers can't read note contents, is an adjacent security control rather than a documented guarantee against model training. It also reportedly excludes uploaded files and images. With no Reflect capability or policy addressing AI training, the applicable axis is unmet.
